rating.label: CARE rating
rating.summary: Rationale and key rating drivers Reaffirmation of ratings assigned to long-term debt instruments of Union Bank of India (UBI) factor in the bank’s comfortable capitalisation levels supported by internal accruals and equity raise in FY24. CARE Ratings Limited (CareEdge Ratings) expects the bank’s asset quality parameters to remain stable in the near term.
